research_question: Within one real satellite dataset, which feature-budgeted MSF variants provide a reasonable cost-vs-anomaly-detection tradeoff?
source: OPS-SAT-AD genuine 303493 raw points, 2123 labeled segments, 2560 deterministic multi-scale descriptors plus original 18
important_evidence_warning: Prior work already inspected independent random audits of official train=1; this new reseeded internal audit is exploratory, not a fresh independent confirmatory test.
fisher: Fisher scores computed on fit only; top-k feature masks for each fixed budget

budgeted_msf.selected_subset_size: between 50 percent of budget and budget, chosen from nondominated candidates within 0.025 of best wrapper G-mean
budgeted_msf.search_budget_cap: number of selected descriptors <= feature budget

primary_evaluation: first-run end-to-end cost excluding raw extraction

calibration_only_recommendation.choose: minimum selector+10x training cost among candidates satisfying constraints, no audit involvement

prohibited: No post-hoc use of audit to choose tuning
No raw feature leakage from different segments
No change to frozen delivery branch
No claim NSGA2 budget adaptation is patent novel without prior-art review
